AutoHotkey v2.0.31 (64-bit) is included, unchanged, so the ChurchLight clicker helper works without a separate
download. It is a separate program, run on its own; ChurchLight Presenter does not link to it.

AutoHotkey is free software under the GNU General Public License version 2 (license.txt in this folder).
Its source code is available from https://github.com/AutoHotkey/AutoHotkey (the v2.0.31 release) and from
https://www.autohotkey.com/. The file AutoHotkey64.exe here is the one from the official AutoHotkey_2.0.31.zip.
